command_raw:
echo "===== FASE 4: Proyectos - archive/ppk a cold, external borrar ====="

# Crear directorio cold
mkdir -p ~/projects/cold

# Mover archive a cold
if [ -d ~/projects/archive ] && [ "$(ls -A ~/projects/archive)" ]; then
  mv ~/projects/archive/* ~/projects/cold/
  rmdir ~/projects/archive
  echo "✓ ~/projects/archive/* movido a ~/projects/cold/"
else
  echo "~/projects/archive ya vacío o no existe"
fi

# Mover ppk a cold (trabajo antiguo)
if [ -d ~/projects/ppk ] && [ "$(ls -A ~/projects/ppk)" ]; then
  mv ~/projects/ppk/* ~/projects/cold/
  rmdir ~/projects/ppk
  echo "✓ ~/projects/ppk/* movido a ~/projects/cold/"
else
  echo "~/projects/ppk ya vacío o no existe"
fi

# Borrar external (revanced-manager - no tuyo)
if [ -d ~/projects/external ]; then
  rm -rf ~/projects/external
  echo "✓ ~/projects/external borrado"
else
  echo "~/projects/external no existe"
fi

# tools/ - son repos externos que usas via opencode/app, organizar
# Mantener solo los esenciales, mover resto a cold
mkdir -p ~/tools/cold

# Lista de esenciales que SÍ usas via opencode/app
ESSENTIALS="engram opencode-hooks oh-my-openagent superpowers agentmemory codebase-memory-mcp metronous gentle-ai code-review-graph hallmark destructive_command_guard"

cd ~/tools
for d in *; do
  if [ -d "$d" ] && [ "$d" != "cold" ]; then
    is_essential=0
    for e in $ESSENTIALS; do
      if [ "$d" = "$e" ]; then
        is_essential=1
        break
      fi
    done
    if [ $is_essential -eq 0 ]; then
      echo "Moviendo ~/tools/$d a cold/ (no esencial)"
      mv "$d" ~/tools/cold/
    else
      echo "MANTENIENDO ~/tools/$d (esencial)"
    fi
  fi
done

echo "✓ ~/tools/ organizado - esenciales en ~/tools/, resto en ~/tools/cold/"
ls -la ~/tools/
ls -la ~/tools/cold/ 2>/dev/null | head -10
